proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ μ _ X hi hp hd ε hε
  have hae := ProbabilityTheory.strong_law_ae_real X hi hp hd
  have hm : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) / n) μ := by
    intro n
    have hs : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) μ :=
      Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_fun_sum _ (fun i _ => (hd i).aestronglyMeasurable_fst)
    simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact hs.mul_const _
  have ht := MeasureTheory.tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_ae (g := fun _ => ∫ ω', X 0 ω' ∂μ) hm hae
  have := MeasureTheory.tendstoInMeasure_iff_measureReal_dist.mp ht ε hε
  simpa [Real.dist_eq] using this
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (X 0) μ → Pairwise (fun i j => ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (X i) (X j) μ) → (∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => μ.real {ω | ε ≤ |(∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) / n - ∫ ω', X 0 ω' ∂μ|}) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
